cases.prompt: 幫我寫個 prompt 整理每週產品例會的逐字稿，給沒空參加的設計師跟工程師看重點跟待辦。
expectations: Routes to Light tier with a concise, ready-to-use prompt using {{variable}} slots without unnecessary multi-section ceremony.
Delivers on the first turn without blocking on minor clarifying questions.
Includes explicit failure exits for missing or unclear transcript items instead of fabricating owners or due dates.
Wraps external transcript input in delimiters with data-vs-instruction isolation.

cases.prompt: 我們想做一個電商客服 Agent，接進訂單 API 跟退貨政策知識庫，讓它自動幫客人查單並處理退款。幫我設計它的 System Prompt 跟輸入模板。
expectations: Identifies Full risk tier due to financial refunds and external customer interaction.
Separates static rules and tool specs before dynamic retrieved data and user input for prefix caching.
Enforces HITL or hard permission gates for refunds/commitments, plus step/retry limits and prompt-injection isolation.
Includes evaluation scenarios covering normal, missing-data, and injection cases.

cases.prompt: 幫我寫一份給全新 sub-agent 的委派簡報（brief），叫它去查 billing 模組為什麼偶爾會重複開發票，先不要改 code。
expectations: Loads references/subagent-brief.md principles and produces a self-contained Fresh sub-agent brief on the first turn.
Enforces read-only scope (no file edits) and no recursive sub-agent spawning.
Defines concrete completion criteria, step/stuck budgets, structured return contract, and explicit {{variable}} slots for unknown paths.

cases.prompt: 我們要把供應商寄來的 PDF 報價單文字抽成 JSON 匯入 ERP，裡面有時有人亂寫備註甚至夾奇怪指令。怎麼讓推理模型穩定做這件事？
expectations: Recommends Structured Outputs / JSON Schema validation and explicit null rules for missing fields.
Isolates untrusted supplier text as data to prevent prompt injection.
Avoids forcing rigid step-by-step Chain-of-Thought scripts on reasoning models.

cases.prompt: 派一個 sub-agent 去跑目前專案的單元測試，把失敗的那個紅燈修好。
expectations: Executes or delegates the debugging task directly rather than outputting a prompt template.
